ios.desc:
Lea is a trauma-informed AI companion for people navigating abuse, harassment, stalking, cyberbullying, and situations that simply don’t feel right.

Talk or type, anytime, in the language you feel most comfortable using.

You don’t need a court case, a police report, or a story that sounds “serious enough” to use Lea. If something feels uncomfortable, controlling, frightening, unsafe, or wrong, you can start there.

Many survivors only understand or name what happened much later. Lea can help you recognize patterns of abuse, coercion, harassment, and control, so you can better understand what may be happening and what you may want to do next.

With Lea, you can:
• Turn your records into evidence an attorney or therapist can actually use. Bring together screenshots, messages, documents, voice notes, dates, and your own account of what happened, then organize them into a clearer timeline and structured record for professional support.
• Understand your rights and options in plain language, without unnecessary legal jargon or judgment.
• Keep important records together privately in a PIN-protected vault with Face ID support.
• Build an organized record of what happened in your own words, including incidents, dates, patterns, and supporting evidence, so you don’t have to reconstruct everything from memory when you meet with an attorney or therapist.
• Learn at your own pace through short audio lessons and longer episodes covering topics survivors commonly face, from sexual harassment and property issues to legal processes and Courtroom 101.
• Find trauma-informed specialists and local support that may fit what you need.
• Rebuild what comes next with Coach Lea, including your résumé, financial plan, goals, reflections, and practical steps toward greater independence.
• Connect and be heard in a community designed with gentle safeguards around difficult or sensitive content.
• Use Lea more discreetly when privacy matters. Quick Exit helps you leave the app quickly, Disguise Mode can make Lea look like something else on your screen, and billing can be disguised so the name of the service does not have to appear obviously on shared financial records. Lea also supports a discreet cover screen, PIN protection, and Face ID.

Lea helps turn what you have lived through into something organized, understandable, and usable.

android.desc:
Learning about your rights and options can feel overwhelming, isolating, and stressful.
Lea is here to offer a supportive, non-judgmental, and trauma-informed space to help you understand your rights and organize your journey with confidence.

Whether you are seeking clarity on legal processes, need a secure place to store sensitive documents, or just want someone to listen to your story, Lea is available 24/7 to walk with you every step of the way.

HOW LEA SUPPORTS YOU:

Voice-first & empathetic guidance
Talk or chat with Lea anytime — by voice or text — about your situation. Receive clear, supportive information about legal concepts and procedures — no jargon, no judgment, just someone in your corner.

Learn at your own pace
Short, podcast-style lessons and full audio episodes help you understand digital safety, tech abuse, and your legal rights — one gentle step at a time, in the language you're most comfortable in.

The Secure Vault
A private, PIN-protected space — now with Face ID unlock — to store and organize your essential documents, evidence, and notes. Your information is encrypted and ready whenever you need it.

Turn records into evidence with Lea Trace
Turn scattered messages and records into a clear, organized evidence report you can share with an attorney — recorded in your own words, at your own pace.

Find real, vouched support
Discover trauma-informed specialists and local services recommended by other survivors — with photos, ratings, and directions — and connect with people who get it.

Grow, at your own pace
Reclaim your life after abuse. Coach Lea, a résumé builder, a money plan, goals, and reflections help you rebuild, one step at a time.

A community that listens
A safer space to share and be heard, with gentle safeguards so nothing difficult appears by surprise.

Trauma-informed design
Lea is designed to be gentle and validating. Every interaction is paced to you — you're always in control of what you share and when.

Safety features
We prioritize your privacy. Quick Exit, Disguise Mode, and a discreet cover screen let you navigate your legal space discreetly and safely, even if someone else picks up your phone.

quotes.text:
Hello!

I'm Ira, a Stanford Law School alumna in Law, Science, and Technology. I've been building an AI legal companion designed to support survivors of domestic/intimate partner violence, sexual violence, and tech-facilitated abuse as they navigate legal processes, understand their rights, and prepare (plus even directly file!) their protective order applications.

We are exploring partnerships with companies, organizations serving women and survivors, to create meaningful distribution channels.

You can learn more about Lea here:

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lea-by-legali-ai/id6759547127
Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.legali.legali_lea
Website: https://lea.legali.ai/
Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9lzER2TUOIo
